summary: The vsftpd 2.3.4 download was backdoored and opens a command shell on port 6200.
Stack-based buffer overflows in ProFTPD's Telnet IAC handling (fixed in 1.3.3c) can allow remote code execution. Score is CVSS v2.
mod_mime can read one byte past the end of a buffer when handling a crafted Content-Type header.
